text_block_list.text:
Worried about Mayano Top Gun, who didn't show up for training,
I went looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What are you looking around for??
Did you lose something~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah! Could what you're looking for be... Maya, perhaps? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, wanna play hide-and-seek together?
I was just playing with my friends right now♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, there's nothing here............ Ah.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see, training.
Were you worried... because Maya didn't show up?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! Maya didn't mean
to make you look so sad!
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to be careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I won't make you worry anymore!
Because I want to see you smiling, Trainer-chan!
